units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 9a:3">R. Hash. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ של שביעית וכ׳</he> a ripening in the Sabbatical year which goes over into the eighth year, i.e. plants which were partly ripe in the Sabbatical year are subject to the laws of the Sabbatical year.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 9a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>קְצִיר העומר</he> the cutting of the ʿOmer (v. <cite ref="P00288"><he>עוֹמֶר</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:5">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 17:11">Is. XVII, 11</cite>) <he>קְצִירָן של מלכיות</he> (<cite ref="S01809"><he>קְצִירִין</he></cite>) the cutting down (destruction threatened) by the government; <he>ק׳ של יסורין</he> by sufferings; <he>קְצִירוֹ של מלאך וכ׳</he> the cutting down by the angel of death, v. <cite ref="N00234"><he>נִדְנֵד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 287:3">Yalk. Is. 287</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="S01809"><he>קְצִירִין</he></cite>, v. supra.
